contract: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= k <= 18","description":"The value of k must be between 1 and 18 inclusive."},{"id":"P2","expression":"len(s) == 2**k - 1","description":"The length of the string s must be equal to 2^k - 1."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= q <= 200000","description":"The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200000 inclusive."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for c in s)","description":"All characters in the string s must be either '0', '1', or '?'}},{"id":"P5","expression":"all(1 <= p <= len(s) and c in {'0', '1', '?'} for p, c in queries)","description":"Each query must have a valid position p and character c."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(f(s))","description":"The output must be the number of possible winners of the tournament after processing each query."}],"invariants":[]}
